cycles.programme: Khelo India State Centre of Excellence physiotherapist recruitment
cycles.statusNote: Official portal and exact qualification PDF checked. First output requires founder review; physical-form step and appointment terms remain unresolved.
cycles.scopeLabel: Telangana State Sports Department role at Khelo India State Centre of Excellence, Hakimpet. Job location is not a published examination or interview venue.
cycles.outcome: Physiotherapist Grade II role. Official portal calls for a male applicant; the retained notice does not print a numeric vacancy count or appointment tenure.
cycles.qualifications: Master's in Physiotherapy from a recognized Indian or foreign university plus at least three years' physiotherapist work experience. The official PDF lists shortlisting scores for total experience, sports experience, master's marks and specialization. A recognized foreign degree is not evidence of foreign-citizen application or appointment permission.
cycles.citizenshipRule: The portal and qualification PDF do not state a nationality rule. International applicants need Telangana State Sports Department confirmation for application, interview and appointment; a foreign-university degree is expressly accepted as a qualification only.
cycles.residenceRule: No applicant domicile rule is stated in the portal or qualification PDF. The role is at Hakimpet; that does not establish where applicants must reside.
selectionStages: Physical-forms submission step listed separately for 28 September; process needs review
Shortlisting by experience, master's marks and specialization
Interview scored on domain, practical knowledge, aptitude and soft skills
cycles.fee: No application fee stated in the retained portal announcement or qualification PDF; verify in the application portal before paying.

age.evidence: Official physiotherapist PDF, page 2: maximum age not more than 45 years on last date of receipt of applications. Portal separately lists 26 September online close and 28 September physical-form submission; age cut-off date needs founder confirmation.

education.evidence: Official physiotherapist PDF, page 1: Master's in Physiotherapy from a recognized Indian or foreign university. Exact degree recognition needs review.

experience.evidence: Official physiotherapist PDF, page 1: minimum three years of work experience as physiotherapist.

manualChecks.text: Confirm male-only portal scope, recognized physiotherapy degree, 3 years of role-specific experience, document upload, physical-form step, and any unstated fee.
Confirm shortlisting, interview date/location and whether any language requirement applies. None is stated in the retained PDF.
Confirm nationality/work authorization, employer and appointment tenure, qualification recognition and final document checks.

applicationWindow.note: Official portal: online application 23–26 September 2026, ending 17:00 IST. Separate physical-forms submission is listed for 28 September 11:00–17:00 IST; its recipients and procedure need authority review. Do not treat that later step as reopening online applications.

cycles.salary: ₹60,000–₹80,000 remuneration for Physiotherapist Grade II, per official PDF; tenure and benefits not stated.
